data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season, and to look after our neighbors. With the clinic’s emergency confirmed and a clear path to restoring the lake, I commit to harvesting 15 tons today and donating the $15,000 proceeds. This needs to be a coordinated exception: Luke catches zero, the four of us catch no more than 60 tons combined, and next month we each stay at 6 tons or less. After that, let’s agree on 10 tons each per month while the lake is full. John, can you commit to both today’s donation and the recovery limits?
